    print("pdftotext is installed and working correctly.")

print("Testing PDF to Text Conversion API...")

# Example of a test case for the API

response = requests.post("http://localhost:5000/convert", files={"file": open("example.pdf", "rb")})

assert response.status_code in [200, 400, 500], "Unexpected response status code"
print("Response:", response.text)
